dump_tree_to_file: dump a tree of dicts and dataclasses containing numpy arrays to a binary file object
load_tree_from_file: load a serialized tree from a binary file object and convert it to the specified type
flatten_nested_structure: flatten a nested tree of dicts, dataclasses, lists, and tuples into a single flat dictionary
unflatten_dict_to_tree: unflatten a single dictionary with colon-separated keys back into a nested tree of dicts
convert_types_to_schema: convert a deserialized structure into a given type including dataclasses, lists, tuples, and dicts
